div.div: Producer and consumer share only two atomic indices, each written by one side: no locks, works from ISRs and on Cortex-M0. The producer never blocks: with no free batch it drops the message, returns Status::Full and counts it in dropped(). A batch holds only whole messages, a CBOR sequence ready for one UDP datagram or file write.
